pages.text: New meats cook in a furnace, smoker or over a campfire. On Farmer's Delight's cutting board a knife turns them into minced beef, chicken cuts, bacon or cod slices for its recipes.
pages.title: Wild Meats

pages.text: With a cooking addon installed, Alex's Mobs Delight or Alex's Delight, carcasses give that addon's own meat for the creatures it covers instead of ours, ready for its recipes. See $(l:butchery:alexsbutchery/cooking_addons)Cooking Addons$().
